ModMetaData.name: Leatherworks
ModMetaData.author: throwingfish
ModMetaData.description:
Leather and padded armor and neolithic weaponry for early-game and tribal colonies.
Adds a jerkin, cap and greaves in plain leather, studded leather, and padded variants, as well as a leather sling for hurling stones with blunt damage. Protection scales with the fabric and leather used; studded pieces gain protection from metal studs, while padded pieces combine fabric with leather padding for extra blunt resistance and cold insulation.
No DLC required.
